_comment: The AdMob identities the shells are built with. install-ads.mjs writes the
platform's block into the shell's index.html as window.__phaseAds and the
App ID into the Android manifest / iOS Info.plist.
THESE ARE GOOGLE'S PUBLISHED TEST IDS. They show 'Test Ad' banners and pay
nothing; a store build must carry the owner's real ones. Real IDs in a
debug build are a policy strike the other way. The owner pastes the real
ones in (docs/ADS-STEP-BY-STEP.md step 4) and sets testing to false in the
release commit that carries them. An App ID has a ~ in it; an ad unit ID
testDevices: AdMob device ids for phones that should see test ads even on
a live build (the owner's). consentDebug forces the EEA consent form on
those devices so the form can be seen outside Europe.
